sources.title: RFC 6585: additional HTTP status codes
sources.supportRationale: 429 and optional Retry-After behavior; counting policy is application-specific.

sources.title: AWS Builders Library: making retries safe with idempotent APIs
sources.supportRationale: Caller-provided request identity, late requests and same-key/different-intent handling.

sources.title: GraphQL: execution
sources.supportRationale: Resolver execution and selected field results.

sources.title: gRPC: status codes
sources.supportRationale: RPC status distinguishes conditions and must not be inferred solely from HTTP transport status.
